description: A predicate \(A\) on natural numbers is computably enumerable if and only if some primitive-recursive relation \(R(x,t)\) satisfies \(A(x)\Longleftrightarrow\exists t\,R(x,t)\) for every \(x\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.enumerable_iff_primitive_certificate (A : ℕ → Prop) :
  REPred A ↔ ∃ R, (PrimrecPred fun p => R p.1 p.2) ∧ ∀ (x : ℕ), A x ↔ ∃ t, R x t
